files.name: predictions.csv

columns.name: vtu_name
columns.note: Test-vehicle filename exactly as keyed in data/frontal_areas.json (including @05000.vtu suffix). Must cover every vehicle in the test set with no duplicates.

columns.name: Cd_pred
columns.note: Predicted aerodynamic drag coefficient Cd. Evaluated against private ground-truth Cd values via mean relative error. Value must be a finite float within the physical range [0.05, 1.5].

structural_checks: All test-set vtu_name values must be present (no missing vehicles)
Cd_pred must be finite (no NaN, no Inf)
Cd_pred must be within physical range [0.05, 1.5]
